name: Oil (Brent)
summary: Brent near $90 on 20 Nov, 23% lower over a month; Hormuz tanker attacks continue without a confirmed 2 mb/d outage
state: Brent closed near $89.95 on 20 Nov, 23% lower over a month and inside the $85–110 Watch band (Yahoo Finance). Tanker attacks around Hormuz continue, with a tanker hit north of Khasab on 18 Nov (Gulf News), and Lloyd's List Intelligence counted October as the busiest month for Hormuz traffic since the conflict began. No new outage above 2 mb/d is confirmed, so Watch holds.
for_you: Oil is well below its autumn peak but still elevated. Fuel and heating costs remain exposed to further shipping attacks in the Gulf.

why: Oil feeds inflation, transport and household budgets; price spikes have preceded most post-war recessions.
drivers: OPEC+ output, Middle East supply risk, sanctions, demand, inventories, shipping disruption.

rubric.alert: Brent > $110, or 1-month change > +30%, or a major physical supply outage (> 2 mb/d).
